transport.commands: UTF-8 newline-delimited JSON on child stdin; maximum 1048576 bytes per line excluding newline
transport.messages: child stdout: uint32LE header_bytes, uint32LE payload_bytes, UTF-8 JSON header, binary payload
transport.parent_eof: destroy all surfaces and exit without waiting for pending commands
transport.launcher: electron helper/stdio.cjs with ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1; after assigning process-tree ownership and configuring streams, parent sends private first line {type:start}; only then broker spawns the hidden GUI renderer over a private authenticated local pipe, with no TCP listener
transport.windows_bootstrap: GUI Electron emits a startup CRLF and cannot read parent stdin; the Node-mode broker routes GUI bootstrap diagnostics to stderr, keeping public stdout strictly binary
transport.profile: private temporary Chromium userData/sessionData per broker; surfaces in a process share the profile, separate renderer processes never share cache or profile locks; broker removes only its owned temporary directory

identity.generation: positive safe integer, increasing when an id is recreated

input.text: committed Unicode text; full native IME candidate/composition integration is not provided
input.focus: logical Chromium focus emulation only; the native helper window stays hidden and unfocusable

messages.ready: global protocol/electron/pid handshake; per-surface ready also contains identity, width/height, resize_revision, visible:false, focused:false

frame.payload: exactly width * height * 4 bytes; whole frame
frame.seq: starts at 1, strictly increasing per generation; dropped frames cause gaps
frame.resize_revision: starts at 0, increases once per accepted resize including unchanged dimensions; old-size frames are discarded
frame.scale: device scale forced to 1, CSS dimensions equal pixel dimensions

backpressure: one in-flight envelope plus a latest-frame mailbox per surface; pending output bytes bounded to 64 MiB plus one header; control messages are ordered and take priority over pending frames
bridge: existing @auroraview/sdk event_bridge; no arbitrary eval command and no exposed native plugin invocation
